newsitem.title: USA: CIBC adds former Citicorp securitization team.
newsitem.headline: CIBC adds former Citicorp securitization team.

text.p: CIBC Wood Gundy said on Monday it hired a four-person structured securitization team formerly employed by Citicorp.
Ken Wormser, formerly chief of Citicorp's securitization unit,joined CIBC as a managing director, CIBC said.
John Gevlin also joined as a managing director, while Ralph Inglese and David Duncan have signed on as directors.

Wormser and Inglese will focus on CIBC's structuring business, while Gevlin and Duncan will work with the firm's non-investment-grade clients, CIBC said. The team had similar responsibilities with Citicorp, it said.
